environment.description: Deployed as ECS Fargate task behind AWS ALB with API Gateway HTTP API (v2) as the entry point. The API Gateway integration uses VPC Link to the ALB. Rate limiting is configured via a usage plan with throttle settings: 10 requests/second burst, 5 requests/second steady-state per source IP, enforced at the API Gateway layer which returns HTTP 429 before the request reaches the ALB. Additionally, the API Gateway HTTP API normalizes all inbound requests by stripping Transfer-Encoding headers and re-serializing the body with a computed Content-Length before forwarding via the VPC Link integration. The ALB target group has connection idle timeout of 5 seconds with keep-alive disabled (connection: close forced by ALB listener rule action).
